IT FEELS CURSED.

events.title: LOST CHICK
text: A TINY CHICK IS LOST AND CHEEPING.
A CAT IS PROWLING NEARBY.

events.title: OLD RACCOON
text: A GREY-WHISKERED RACCOON OFFERS TIPS.

events.title: RAT SHAMAN
text: GIVE ME SOME OF YOUR LIFE, BANDIT.
I WILL GIVE YOU POWER.

events.title: BANANA PEEL
text: A BANANA PEEL LIES RIGHT IN YOUR PATH.

events.title: BEAR TRAP
text: A SHINY BOTTLE CAP SITS IN AN OPEN BEAR TRAP.

events.title: AMBUSH!
text: GLOWING EYES IN THE BUSHES.
SOMETHING BIG IS WAITING FOR YOU.

events.title: ELITE ROOST
text: TOUGH CRITTERS GUARD A STASH OF TREASURE.

events.title: BACK-ALLEY DICE
text: RATS ARE ROLLING DICE FOR SHINIES.
DOUBLE OR NOTHING?

events.title: DARK SHORTCUT
text: A GAP IN THE FENCE LEADS STRAIGHT AHEAD.
SOMETHING NASTY LIVES IN THERE.

events.title: ABANDONED PIZZA
text: A WHOLE PIZZA, STILL WARM.
NOBODY IS AROUND.

events.title: ABANDONED GYM
text: RUSTY WEIGHTS AND A HAMSTER WHEEL.
NO PAIN, NO GAIN?

events.title: COZY CAMPFIRE
text: SOMEONE LEFT A FIRE BURNING.
IT IS WARM AND QUIET HERE.

events.title: SQUIRREL BANK
text: A SQUIRREL IN A TINY SUIT OFFERS A DEAL.

events.title: VENDING MACHINE
text: A HUMMING VENDING MACHINE.
ONE SNACK IS STUCK HALFWAY OUT.

events.title: STREET BAND
text: THREE RATS PLAY A CATCHY TUNE.
THE BEAT GETS YOUR PAWS MOVING.

events.title: LOST WALLET
text: A FAT WALLET ON THE SIDEWALK.
THE CARD INSIDE SAYS IT IS A BADGER'S.

events.title: SEWER GRATE
text: SOMETHING GLINTS BELOW A GRATE.
YOU HEAR SQUEAKING DOWN THERE.

events.title: PIGEON COUNCIL
text: A HUNDRED PIGEONS STARE AT YOU.
THEY EXPECT A TRIBUTE.

events.title: BROKEN ROBOT
text: A LITTLE ROBOT SPARKS IN THE SCRAP.
IT BEEPS SADLY AT YOU.

events.title: MYSTERY STALL
text: A MOTH SELLS GLOWING TRINKETS.
PRICES ARE STEEP, STOCK IS RARE.

events.title: BERRY BUSH
text: RED AND PURPLE BERRIES, RIPE AND JUICY.

events.title: WILD BEEHIVE
text: HONEY DRIPS FROM A BUZZING HIVE.

events.title: FISHING SPOT
text: FISH JUMP IN THE CLEAR WATER.

events.title: SCARECROW
text: A SCARECROW WEARS A NICE HAT.
CROWS WATCH YOU FROM THE CORN.

options.label: TAKE THE HAT
options.detail: GET BUCKET HAT, NEXT FIGHT ELITE

events.title: HOLLOW LOG
text: A HOLLOW LOG RUNS DOWNHILL.
IT LOOKS LIKE A SHORTCUT.

events.title: WISE OWL
text: AN OWL ASKS YOU A RIDDLE.
GET IT RIGHT AND IT TEACHES YOU.

events.title: CHICKEN COOP
text: A COOP FULL OF FRESH EGGS.
THE ROOSTER LOOKS VERY ANGRY.

events.title: OASIS
text: COOL WATER UNDER A PALM TREE.

events.title: QUICKSAND
text: THE GROUND SUCKS AT YOUR PAWS!

events.title: SUNKEN CHEST
text: A CHEST SITS IN DEEP WATER.
BUBBLES RISE FROM THE LID.

events.title: FROZEN FOX
text: A FOX KIT IS STUCK IN THE ICE.

events.title: SNAKE CHARMER
text: A MONGOOSE TEACHES SNAKE MOVES.
LESSONS ARE NOT CHEAP.

events.title: COCONUT TREE
text: COCONUTS HANG HIGH UP.

events.title: EMPTY IGLOO
text: A SNUG IGLOO. NOBODY IS HOME.

events.title: GLOWING MUSHROOM
text: A MUSHROOM PULSES WITH PINK LIGHT.

events.title: SINGING CRYSTAL
text: A CRYSTAL HUMS A STRANGE TUNE.

events.title: CANDY HOUSE
text: A HOUSE MADE OF CAKE AND CANDY.
NOBODY SEEMS TO BE HOME.

events.title: FRIENDLY GHOST
text: A LITTLE GHOST WANTS TO TAG ALONG.
IT IS VERY COLD TO TOUCH.

events.title: GIANT CLOCK
text: A HUGE CLOCK TICKS BACKWARDS.

events.title: LAVA FORGE
text: AN ANVIL GLOWS BESIDE A LAVA POOL.

events.title: BOUNCY CLOUD
text: A FLUFFY CLOUD SITS ON THE GROUND.

events.title: BRIGHT LIGHT
text: A SAUCER HUMS OVERHEAD.
A BEAM OF LIGHT SWEEPS THE GROUND.

events.title: MOON CHEESE
text: THE GROUND HERE IS MADE OF CHEESE.

events.title: NEON ARCADE
text: AN OLD ARCADE CABINET BLINKS.
A HIGH SCORE WINS A PRIZE.

events.title: VOID WHISPER
text: THE VOID WHISPERS YOUR NAME.
IT OFFERS TO SHARPEN YOUR MIND.

events.title: DREAM DOOR
text: A DOOR STANDS ALONE IN THE MIST.

events.title: LIGHTNING ROD
text: A METAL ROD CRACKLES ON THE PEAK.

events.title: TRASH THRONE
text: A THRONE OF GARBAGE, FIT FOR A KING.
THE KING IS OUT.
